examined_formations.title: ECOMMERCE_PRODUCT_FEED_DISAPPROVAL_MANAGEMENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 电商商品Feed拒登与多渠道Feed托管
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Current managed feed services publish recurring prices from tens of dollars to four figures per month; VersaFeed starts its small-business fully managed service at $1,495/month.
examined_formations.repeated_workaround: Merchants and agencies repeatedly repair disapprovals, attribute gaps, taxonomy mapping, sync and channel-specific feed rules.
examined_formations.machine_delivery: Most catalog validation, mapping, title transformation and feed publishing is machine-executable.
examined_formations.compounding_asset_test: Cross-customer rule/outcome learning can exist, but mature feed platforms and managed services already own this exact feedback loop.

examined_formations.title: EDI_TRADING_PARTNER_ONBOARDING_AND_MAPPING
examined_formations.chinese_title: EDI交易伙伴接入与映射托管
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Orderful publishes $189/month per trading-partner connection and describes mid-sized legacy implementation costs commonly reaching $50k-$200k; managed EDI is an established paid operating category.
examined_formations.repeated_workaround: Mapping, testing, certification, partner onboarding, spec changes and transaction exceptions recur across trading relationships.
examined_formations.machine_delivery: Mapping and validation are increasingly automatable and API-first.
examined_formations.compounding_asset_test: A trading-partner network and prebuilt maps are highly compounding assets, but that is precisely the moat already owned by SPS Commerce, TrueCommerce, Orderful, Cleo and peers.

examined_formations.title: CONSTRUCTION_TAKEOFF_AND_ESTIMATING
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Current outsourced takeoff providers publish per-project prices from hundreds to many thousands of dollars and embedded estimator retainers around $9k-$14k/month.
examined_formations.repeated_workaround: Contractors repeatedly outsource or spend internal estimator hours on takeoff before bids.
examined_formations.machine_delivery: AI takeoff and estimate drafting are now commercially available across many trades.
examined_formations.compounding_asset_test: Historical takeoff corrections and trade-specific cost catalogs could compound, but exact AI estimating products already implement these assets and final bid-grade judgment remains customer/trade specific.

examined_formations.title: SECURITY_QUESTIONNAIRE_AND_RFP_RESPONSE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 安全问卷与RFP响应自动化
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Current products charge by questionnaire, project or annual allowance; 2026 market surveys show enterprise annual pricing and transaction-like questionnaire pricing.
examined_formations.repeated_workaround: Security and sales teams repeatedly answer near-identical questionnaires and RFP content, often blocking deals.
examined_formations.machine_delivery: Approved-answer retrieval, source citation, drafting, spreadsheet handling and review routing are machine-executable.
examined_formations.compounding_asset_test: Approved answer libraries and evidence graphs compound, but the category already contains many mature and AI-native products.

examined_formations.title: SHORT_FORM_VIDEO_EDITING_RETAINER
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Current agencies publish monthly retainers from hundreds to several thousand dollars for recurring Reels, Shorts and TikTok production.
examined_formations.repeated_workaround: Businesses continuously outsource editing capacity to maintain posting cadence.
examined_formations.machine_delivery: Captioning, clipping, reframing, templating and bulk generation are increasingly automated.
examined_formations.compounding_asset_test: Brand/style memory can accumulate but is customer-specific; creative selection and performance strategy remain recurring judgment while low-cost AI tools commoditize the mechanical layer.

examined_formations.title: AMAZON_SELLER_ACCOUNT_APPEAL_AND_REINSTATEMENT
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Specialist providers publish $499-$699 appeal packages, $1,500-$5,000 higher-touch services and recurring account-protection plans.
examined_formations.repeated_workaround: Sellers repeatedly seek outside help after deactivations, listing removals and rejected appeals.
examined_formations.machine_delivery: Document intake, policy matching, evidence packaging and draft generation can be partly automated.
examined_formations.compounding_asset_test: Historical violation-to-evidence-to-outcome knowledge can compound, but platform-specific specialist firms already hold this know-how and difficult cases require bespoke expert or legal judgment.
